description: Whether Solana data is currently being served: latest probe status and finalized slot. When to use: Before relying on the Solana verdict endpoints, or to explain a 503 from them. Prefer another tool: Not a measure of the Solana network itself, only of this service's access to it; use the latest-slot endpoint to see chain progress. Example: solana_network_health {}
name: solana_network_health

age_seconds.description: Age of our read at response time

as_of.description: When we read the data from Solana (our read time)

cache.description: Cache state; a composite answer reports the worst state of its reads, miss above stale

commitment.description: Every read is at finalized commitment

slot.description: On the health summary, the slot of the latest sample when Solana data is configured and that sample is up; on the history, the highest slot of the window's up samples; otherwise null, never 0 (no sample stored, the latest sample down or without a slot, Solana data not configured, or no up sample with a slot in the window)

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

slot.description: Finalized slot of the latest successful probe

status.description: Latest probe result; `unavailable` while Solana data is not configured

title: Solana data status
